Dive bomb ready! Eastern kingbirds are known for perching in one spot, looking and then flying out to catch insects in the air. Photo by Mara Koenig/USFWS
We spotted this eastern kingbird perched in a tree at Sherburne National Wildlife Refuge in Minnesota. Photo by Courtney Celley/USFWS.
